# BatchCutout

BatchCutout is a browser-based bulk background remover for ecommerce product photos.
It is a NexaFlow Labs product.

Primary site:
https://batchcutout.com/

Pricing:
https://batchcutout.com/pricing/

Contact:
support@batchcutout.com

Core positioning:
- Remove backgrounds from product photos in batches.
- Export transparent PNG files individually or as one organized ZIP.
- Built for Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, eBay, Amazon sellers and small ecommerce teams.
- Images are processed in the user's browser and are not uploaded to BatchCutout servers.
- Free plan: test with 2 images per batch.
- Pro: up to 100 images per batch and 2,000 images per month.
- Current paid plans: founder plan EUR 15/month, monthly Pro EUR 19/month, annual Pro EUR 190/year.

Preferred short description:
BatchCutout removes backgrounds from product photos in batches and exports transparent PNGs or one ZIP for ecommerce workflows.
